content.short: Cardoonz is a hand-drawn Cardano NFT collection inspired by animation styles, cartoon art, and collector culture.
content.description: Cardoonz is a hand-drawn Cardano NFT collection inspired by popular animation and cartoon styles. The project planned 3,000 NFTs across six series, with each series representing a different visual style and including exclusive special pieces. Holders can access merchandise-related benefits, while special Cardoonz holders may receive extra rewards. Its focus is collectible art, animation-inspired design, scarcity, and community ownership inside the Cardano NFT ecosystem for fans and collectors worldwide.
